definitions.explanation: A value passed to a function, method, or command. In programming, the input data that a function receives to produce a result. Also used in mathematics for the independent variable of a function.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{関数|かんすう}→関数：04796_kansuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{引数|ひきすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{引数|ひきすう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{文字列|もじれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}して→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pass a string as the argument.

examples.japanese: {引数|ひきすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っていた→間違う：03036_machigau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦エラー→エラー：08429_eraa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: An error occurred because the number of arguments was wrong.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily a technical term used in programming and mathematics. Pronounced ひきすう, not ⟦いん→いる：00495_iru⟧すう (which means "factor" in math). Very common in Japanese programming documentation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引数|ひきすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧ (to pass an argument)
- {引数|ひきすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take an argument)
- {省略可能|しょうりゃくかのう}な{引数|ひきすう} (optional argument)
- コマンドライン{引数|ひきすう} (command-line argument)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- パラメータ: parameter — often used interchangeably, but technically the variable name in a function definition
- {戻|もど}り{値|ち}: return value — the output of a function, as opposed to the input
